post.originalText:
Gave claude opus 5.5 one prompt and my resume. asked for a 30s motion showreel.

i know zero motion design. never gave it a track.

it composed the audio, synced every cut to the beat, and rendered the mp4 itself.

100x better is possible. still wild.

https://t.co/a8T7mv6eGr

@AnthropicAI @claudeai
